description: This file defines an Android activity 'ScaleToFit' that demonstrates the use of Matrix.ScaleToFit for scaling and fitting oval shapes within a rectangular area on a Canvas. The nested 'SampleView' class handles drawing multiple ovals with different fitting modes and labels.

classes.name: ScaleToFit
classes.description: Main activity class extending GraphicsActivity, sets up content view with the custom SampleView.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Custom View class responsible for rendering the demo using Canvas, Paint, and Matrix to illustrate 'ScaleToFit' fitting modes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of the nested SampleView.

methods.name: setSrcR
methods.description: Sets the source rectangle dimensions based on current data index.

methods.name: drawSrcR
methods.description: Draws an oval shape within the source rectangle, colored according to data.

methods.name: drawFit
methods.description: Draws the oval fitted into the destination rectangle using a specified ScaleToFit mode.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the drawing of the entire view, including multiple ovals and fitting modes with labels.
